title: Introspect OAuth token
description: Ask HubSpot whether a token is still active, and what it is for. Replaces both v1 token-info calls.
summary: check whether a token is active

config.label: Token
config.description: The access token or refresh token to check.

config.label: Token type
config.description: Which kind of token `token` is. Optional; HubSpot works it out when omitted.

outputShape.description: Whether the token is active (RFC 7662). Every other field HubSpot returns is passed through as it arrived.
